rules.statement: A tenant who remains in occupation of leased premises with notice of the purchaser's election to recognize him as a tenant may be regarded as having attorned to the purchaser, establishing privity of contract between them.
rules.supporting_quote: "It would appear, therefore, that a purchaser of Property that had been let was. bound by the lease and had to permit the lessee to continue in occupation till the end of the term of the lease. The purchaser may of course, as against his vendor, insist on vacant possession or, in the alternative, claim rescission of the sale, but if he desires to abide by the sale, he can only take possession along with the lessee in occupation if the latter chooses to continue with the lease."
